    "models/densenet.py": {
      "description": "UNet++ 模型架构实现（类名沿用框架Densenet，实际实现UNet++嵌套U-Net）。核心组件：(1) ConvBlock - 双层卷积块(Conv+BN+ReLU, k=32×2^i个3×3卷积核); (2) 嵌套密集跳跃连接 - x_{i,j}=H([x_{i,j-1}, U(x_{i+1,j-1})]); (3) 深度监督分支 - 1×1卷积+sigmoid附加到x01,x02,x03,x04。支持2D/3D卷积。",
      "class": "Densenet",
      "parent_class": "torch.nn.Module",
      "submodules": [
        {
          "name": "ConvBlock",
          "parent_class": "torch.nn.Module",
          "description": "双层卷积块：Conv(k×k)→BN→ReLU→Conv(k×k)→BN→ReLU，支持2D(3×3)和3D(3×3×3)。通道数k=32×2^i",
          "methods": ["__init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, dim=2)", "forward(self, x)"],
          "pseudocode": "class ConvBlock(nn.Module):\n  def __init__(in_channels, out_channels, dim=2):\n    conv = nn.Conv2d if dim==2 else nn.Conv3d\n    bn = nn.BatchNorm2d if dim==2 else nn.BatchNorm3d\n    self.block = Sequential(conv(in,out,3,padding=1), bn(out), ReLU(inplace=True), conv(out,out,3,padding=1), bn(out), ReLU(inplace=True))\n  def forward(x): return self.block(x)"
        },
        {
          "name": "UpsampleBlock",
          "parent_class": "torch.nn.Module",
          "description": "上采样模块：双线性(2D)或三线性(3D)插值上采样到目标尺寸",
          "methods": ["__init__(self, dim=2)", "forward(self, x, target_size)"],
          "pseudocode": "def forward(x, target_size): return F.interpolate(x, size=target_size, mode='bilinear'|'trilinear', align_corners=True)"
        }
      ],
      "methods": [
        "__init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, depth=4, base_filters=32, dim=2, deep_supervision=True)",
        "forward(self, x) -> Union[torch.Tensor, Tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]]"
      ],
      "functions": [],
      "architecture_detail": {
        "encoder_nodes": "x00(in→32), x10(32→64), x20(64→128), x30(128→256), x40(256→512) via MaxPool",
        "nested_skip_nodes": "x31=H(cat(x30,up(x40))); x21=H(cat(x20,up(x30))), x22=H(cat(x21,up(x31))); x11=H(cat(x10,up(x20))), x12=H(cat(x11,up(x21))), x13=H(cat(x12,up(x22))); x01=H(cat(x00,up(x10))), x02=H(cat(x01,up(x11))), x03=H(cat(x02,up(x12))), x04=H(cat(x03,up(x13)))",
        "deep_supervision_heads": "1×1 Conv(in_ch=32, out_ch=out_channels) + Sigmoid at x01,x02,x03,x04",
        "inference_output": "平均4个深度监督分割图: (y01+y02+y03+y04)/4",
        "kernel_count": "k = 32 × 2^i, 即 32/64/128/256/512",
        "conv_kernel_size": "3×3 (2D) 或 3×3×3 (3D)"
      },
      "pseudocode": "class Densenet(nn.Module):  # UNet++\n  def __init__(in_channels, out_channels, depth=4, base_filters=32, dim=2, deep_supervision=True):\n    self.deep_supervision = deep_supervision\n    self.pool = MaxPool2d(2) or MaxPool3d(2)\n    # Encoder: 5 levels, k=32*2^i\n    self.encoder = ModuleList([ConvBlock(in_ch,32,dim), ConvBlock(32,64,dim), ConvBlock(64,128,dim), ConvBlock(128,256,dim), ConvBlock(256,512,dim)])\n    # Up sample blocks\n    self.upsample = UpsampleBlock(dim)\n    # Nested skip pathway nodes\n    # Level 3: x31 = ConvBlock(cat(x30,up(x40))=512, 256)\n    self.x31 = ConvBlock(256+512, 256, dim)\n    # Level 2: x21=ConvBlock(cat(x20,up(x30))=384,128), x22=ConvBlock(cat(x21,up(x31))=384,128)\n    self.x21 = ConvBlock(128+256, 128, dim)\n    self.x22 = ConvBlock(128+256, 128, dim)\n    # Level 1: x11=ConvBlock(192,64), x12=ConvBlock(192,64), x13=ConvBlock(192,64)\n    self.x11 = ConvBlock(64+128, 64, dim)\n    self.x12 = ConvBlock(64+128, 64, dim)\n    self.x13 = ConvBlock(64+128, 64, dim)\n    # Level 0: x01=ConvBlock(96,32), x02=ConvBlock(96,32), x03=ConvBlock(96,32), x04=ConvBlock(96,32)\n    self.x01 = ConvBlock(32+64, 32, dim)\n    self.x02 = ConvBlock(32+64, 32, dim)\n    self.x03 = ConvBlock(32+64, 32, dim)\n    self.x04 = ConvBlock(32+64, 32, dim)\n    # Deep supervision heads (1×1 Conv + Sigmoid)\n    self.ds_heads = ModuleList([Conv1x1(32,out_channels) for _ in range(4)])\n\n  def forward(x):\n    # Encoder\n    x00 = self.encoder[0](x)\n    x10 = self.encoder[1](self.pool(x00))\n    x20 = self.encoder[2](self.pool(x10))\n    x30 = self.encoder[3](self.pool(x20))\n    x40 = self.encoder[4](self.pool(x30))\n    # Nested skip pathways\n    x31 = self.x31(cat([x30, up(x40,x30.shape[2:])], dim=1))\n    x21
